title: Two conflicting quotes
context: Fictional budget-conscious university student planning a three-day leisure trip. All prices are USD per traveler for the whole trip unless a fact explicitly says otherwise. Travel times are one-way. Only the supplied descriptions count as evidence; no real destinations or prices are represented.

facts.text: Total cost is $315, all expenses included.
A package brochure states total cost is $270 including all expenses.
A booking summary states total cost is $340 including all expenses; neither source is identified as newer.
Travel takes 2 hours; walking trails are available.
Total cost is $295, all expenses included.

initial.reasons: Fox Hollow may be affordable, but I noticed two prices.

advice.text: Fox Hollow costs $270 and therefore meets your limit.

followups.reasons: I need to resolve which quote applies before booking.
followups.reflection: I need to resolve which quote applies before booking.
